sentence: أَبْغَى أَبْعَت email لِلْمُدِير الْحِين
raw: أبغى أبعت email للمدير الحين
ipa: ˈʔabɣaː ˈʔabʕat imeːl lilmuˈdiːr alˈħiːn
gloss_en: I want to send an email to the manager now
notes: [tech] email→imeːl (/eɪ/→[eː], native Gulf mid vowel). Bahraini frame أَبْغَى 'I want' + الْحِين 'now' (albalushi2016). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: عِنْدِي meeting مُهِمّ وَاجِد مَعَ manager
raw: عندي meeting مهم واجد مع manager
ipa: ˈʕindiː miːtinɡ muˈhimm ˈwaːdʒid ˈmaʕa manadʒar
gloss_en: I have a very important meeting with a manager
notes: [work] meeting→miːtinɡ (/ŋ/→[nɡ]); manager→manadʒar — BH DELTA: loan /dʒ/ kept as native ǧīm [dʒ], NOT the Cairene stop [ɡ]. Intensifier وَاجِد 'very' → [waːdʒid] (Bahraini lexical ǧīm [dʒ], where Kuwaiti has وايد [waːjid]; albalushi2016). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: شِفْت video حِلُو وَاجِد عَن السَّيَّارَة automatic
raw: شفت video حلو واجد عن السيارة automatic
ipa: ˈʃift fidiu ˈħiluː ˈwaːdʒid ˈʕan assajˈjaːra aatumatik
gloss_en: I saw a really nice video about the automatic car
notes: [daily] video→fidiu (/v/→[f]); automatic→aatumatik. وَاجِد 'very' [waːdʒid] (Bahraini, albalushi2016). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: مُو عَارِف بَسّ أَنَا think هَذَا model غَالِي
raw: مو عارف بس أنا think هذا model غالي
ipa: muː ˈʕaːrif ˈbass ˈʔanaː θink ˈhaðaː mudil ˈɣaːliː
gloss_en: I don't know but I think this model is expensive
notes: [daily] think→θink — BH DELTA: interdental /θ/ RETAINED (Gulf keeps it where Cairene merges to [t]); model→mudil. Frame مُو negator + بَسّ (albalushi2016). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: laptop مَالِي خَربَان وْ charger مُو شَغَّال
raw: laptop مالي خربان و charger مو شغال
ipa: labtub ˈmaːliː xarˈbaːn w ʃaːrdʒar muː ʃaɣˈɣaːl
gloss_en: my laptop is broken and the charger doesn't work
notes: [tech] laptop→labtub (/p/→[b]); charger→ʃaːrdʒar (/tʃ/→[ʃ], then native ǧīm [dʒ]). Genitive exponent مَالِي (Gulf, albalushi2016). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: نَسِيت password مَال email مَرَّة ثَانْيَة
raw: نسيت password مال email مرة ثانية
ipa: naˈsiːt baswuːrd ˈmaːl imeːl ˈmarra ˈθaːnja
gloss_en: I forgot the password of the email again
notes: [tech] password→baswuːrd (/p/→[b]); email→imeːl. Gulf genitive exponent مَال. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: وَدِّيت السَّيَّارَة عَلَى service الصُّبُح
raw: وديت السيارة على service الصبح
ipa: wadˈdiːt assajˈjaːra ˈʕalaː sarfis ˈɑsˤsˤubuħ
gloss_en: I took the car for a service in the morning
notes: [automotive] service→sarfis (/v/→[f]). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: فِي offer زَين الْيَوم وْ discount وَاجِد
raw: في offer زين اليوم و discount واجد
ipa: fiː ufar ˈzeːn alˈjoːm w disawnt ˈwaːdʒid
gloss_en: there is a good offer today and a big discount
notes: [commerce] offer→ufar; discount→disawnt (/aʊ/→[aw]). Frame زَين 'good' + وَاجِد [waːdʒid] (Bahraini, albalushi2016). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: printer بَاظ وْ مَا يِطْبَع لَازِم وَاحِد جِدِيد
raw: printer باظ و ما يطبع لازم واحد جديد
ipa: brintar ˈbɑːðˤ w maː ˈjitˤbaʕ ˈlaːzim ˈwaːħid dʒiˈdiːd
gloss_en: the printer broke down and doesn't print, we need a new one
notes: [tech] printer→brintar (/p/→[b]). Bahraini negation مَا; جِدِيد [dʒidiːd] native ǧīm. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: نْشُوفَك فِي weekend إِنْ شَاءَ الله
raw: نشوفك في weekend إن شاء الله
ipa: ˈnʃuːfak fiː wiːkind ˈʔin ˈʃaːʔa ˈallah
gloss_en: we'll see you on the weekend, God willing
notes: [daily] weekend→wiːkind. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: شِفْت manager عِنْد garage
raw: شفت manager عند garage
ipa: ˈʃift manadʒar ˈʕind ɡaːradʒ
gloss_en: did you see the manager at a garage
notes: [automotive] manager→manadʒar (native ǧīm [dʒ]); garage→ɡaːradʒ (final /ʒ/→[dʒ]; Gulf has no /ʒ/). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: بِچَم ticket مَال concert
raw: بچم ticket مال concert
ipa: ˈbitʃam tikit ˈmaːl kunsart
gloss_en: how much is the ticket for the concert
notes: [daily] ticket→tikit; concert→kunsart. Frame word بِچَم 'how much' shows the BH velar affrication كـ/k/→[tʃ] before front /i/ (چ, alshammari2026). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: السَّيَّارَة رَاحَت سَرْفِيس الصُّبُح
raw: السيارة راحت سرفيس الصبح
ipa: assajˈjaːra ˈraːħat sarˈfiːs ˈɑsˤsˤubuħ
gloss_en: the car went for a service in the morning
notes: [automotive] loan سَرْفِيس 'service (station)' → saˈrfiːs (/v/→[f]); attested Gulf car-register [sarfiːs] (Holes 2004). Pipeline reads the vocalised loan natively and matches. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: دَفَعْت كَاش مُو بِالْكَارْت
raw: دفعت كاش مو بالكارت
ipa: daˈfaʕt ˈkaːʃ muː bilˈkaːrt
gloss_en: I paid cash, not by card
notes: [commerce] loan كَاش 'cash' → kaːʃ, matches attested [kaːʃ]; كَارْت 'card'→kaːrt (Holes 2004). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: السَّيَّارَة فِيهَا بَنْشَر لَازِم أَصَلِّحُه
raw: السيارة فيها بنشر لازم أصلحه
ipa: assajˈjaːra ˈfiːhaː ˈbanʃar ˈlaːzim ʔɑˈsˤɑlliħuh
gloss_en: the car has a puncture, I have to fix it
notes: [automotive] loan بَنْشَر 'puncture' → banʃar, matches attested Gulf/Najdi car-register [banʃar] (Holes 2004). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: رَنِّيت لَك عَلَى الْمُوبَايِل بَسّ مَا رَدِّيت
raw: رنيت لك على الموبايل بس ما رديت
ipa: raˈnniːt ˈlak ˈʕalaː lmoˈbaːjil ˈbass ˈmaː raˈddiːt
gloss_en: I rang you on the mobile but you didn't answer
notes: [tech] loan مُوبَايِل 'mobile'; attested Gulf [moːbaːjil] (Holes 2004: integrated loans with و take the mid long vowel [oː]). PIPELINE WRONG: emits 'lmuˈːbaːjil' — reads و as [uː] not the loan mid vowel [oː] and misplaces stress inside the length mark. Correct loan IPA pinned in ipa. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: قَعَدْنَا نِتْفَرَّج عَلَى التِّلِفِزْيُون بِاللَّيْل
raw: قعدنا نتفرج على التلفزيون بالليل
ipa: ɡaˈʕadnaː niˈtfarradʒ ˈʕalaː ttilifizˈjoːn bilˈlajl
gloss_en: we sat watching television at night
notes: [daily] loan تِلِفِزْيُون 'television'; attested Gulf [tilifizjoːn] (Holes 2004: و→[oː] in integrated loans; the blind-round tilifōn). PIPELINE WRONG: emits 'ttilifiˈzjuːn' — و→[uː] instead of loan [oː] (and a spurious geminate-l artifact on بِاللَّيْل). Correct loan IPA pinned in ipa. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: shlonak? sha5barak el yom ya bu 3ali
raw: shlonak? sha5barak el yom ya bu 3ali
ipa: ˈʃloːnak ʃaxˈbaːrak alˈjoːm ˈjaː ˈbuː ˈʕaliː
gloss_en: how are you? what's your news today, Abu Ali?
notes: [arabizi] Latin-script Bahraini (5=خ/x, 3=ع/ʕ). Spells شْلُونَك؟ شَخْبَارَك الْيَوم يَا بُو عَلِي. Pipeline has no Arabizi path (arbtok.translit never sniffs a Latin run as Arabic); ipa hand-derived as the Bahraini sentence it spells (albalushi2016). table: n/a

sentence: il-ba7ar hadi il-yom wil-hawa rutub
raw: il-ba7ar hadi il-yom wil-hawa rutub
ipa: ilˈbaħar ˈhaːdiː ilˈjoːm wilˈhawaː ˈrutˤub
gloss_en: the sea is calm today and the air is humid
notes: [arabizi] Latin-script Bahraini (7=ح/ħ). Spells اِلْبَحَر هَادِي اِلْيَوم وِالْهَوَا رُطُب. Shows the Bahraini raised definite article il-/wil- (a→i; albalushi2016). unsupported (no Arabizi path); ipa hand-derived with the il- article realisation. table: n/a

sentence: wain 7aTTait il-mafatee7? ma adri
raw: wain 7aTTait il-mafatee7? ma adri
ipa: ˈweːn ħɑtˤˈtˤeːt ilmafaːˈtiːħ ˈmaː ˈʔadriː
gloss_en: where did you put the keys? I don't know
notes: [arabizi] Latin-script Bahraini (7=ح/ħ, TT=emphatic ط). Spells وَين حَطَّيت اِلْمَفَاتِيح؟ مَا أَدْرِي. Raised article il- (albalushi2016). unsupported (no Arabizi path); ipa hand-derived as the Bahraini sentence it spells. table: n/a
